observations: Photo shows a white PlayStation 4 console (slim/Pro not clearly distinguishable from this angle).
Two red retail-style boxes in the foreground; text on one box reads 'Wireless Controller'.
A black power cable and a black cable are visible on top of the console.
No clear close-up of the console model label (CUH code) or any 'PS4 Pro' marking.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable CUH model code or clear 'PS4 Pro' marking to confirm Pro vs non-Pro.

claims.claim: It will give smoother gameplay and faster performance.
claims.evidence: No benchmark/performance proof; also Pro status is not confirmed from the photo.
Photo 0 shows a box labeled 'Wireless Controller' and a controller box is present.

risks.risk: Console may not be PS4 Pro (could be a standard PS4 or another variant).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the console’s rear label showing the CUH model number (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro) and a photo of the front/side branding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-Pro PS4 (worst case vs the seller’s 'Pro' claim).

risks.risk: Controller may be missing, not paired, or not working (sticks/buttons/charging).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the controller powering on, pairing to the console, and responding in a game/menu (moving cursor + pressing buttons).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only / controller not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: Console may have faults (disc drive issues, overheating, noisy fan, HDMI/USB ports not working).
risks.proof: Ask for a video booting to the PS4 home screen and inserting a disc (or showing a game launch) plus a quick check of HDMI output and at least one USB port.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case partial faults (e.g., disc drive not confirmed).

risks.risk: Cables/accessories may be incomplete (power cable/HDMI/controller charging cable).
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo of all included items: power cable, HDMI cable, controller charging method/cable, and any other accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the visible essentials are included.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the PS4 rear label with the CUH model code (to confirm Pro).
Video: power on → PS4 home screen loads successfully.
Video: controller pairing + button/joystick response test.
Video or photo: disc drive test (insert a disc and show it loading) OR confirm it’s digital-only with proof.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (power, HDMI, controller charging cable).
response.reason: The photo shows a PS4 console and a 'Wireless Controller' box, but it does’t clearly confirm the console is specifically a PS4 Pro or verify functionality. Missing the CUH model label and working tests prevents a confident worst-case price.
